# AssetShield

> AssetShield is a Laravel-native asset protection layer for Vite-powered applications. It keeps server-side source files outside the public web root, serves compiled assets behind opaque signed/expiring URLs, provides registry-only file resolution, optional deterministic filename masking (with a secret legend), optional vendor-safe JS obfuscation, a CSP/nonce helper, and disables source maps — while preserving standard Laravel Vite behavior. It never claims browser-delivered code can be made impossible to inspect.
